title: Townsend Brown's shortwave contact with space brothers
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Townsend Brown's shortwave contact with space brothers, about 20th century at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and then and then towns and brown would constantly talk about uh you know space brothers and communication with aliens.
he's claimed he was like kind of communicating with aliens half the time.
tellings.difference: Credits Agnew Bahnson and says Brown claimed this 'half the time', without mentioning shortwave or space brothers.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Townsend Brown claiming to communicate with aliens.

as_told.title: Townsend Brown's claimed contact with aliens
